audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Teemo levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items while every matching why says Neeko wins those stages ('a trade his blind-and-poke kit can't answer', 'you trend ahead', 'own the mid-game pick windows').
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Skill and matches the prose exactly; the layers were rendering the opposite answer to their own text on five rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 set to the packet order in both layers with matching ratings.

audit.why: Level 2-3 poke window, level 6 Pop Blossom, first-item Liandry's/Blackfire and his late shroom-map spike are the right four and correctly ordered.

audit.whatIsWrong: The ult setup was credited to 'W invis' and 'W clone-and-invis', and the packet flags that the page never names Teemo's abilities beyond the dart.
audit.why: Neeko's Shapesplitter is a directional clone with a third-attack proc — no invisibility; Inherent Glamour's disguise is what hides Pop Blossom's preparation. Teemo's real names: Guerrilla Warfare (brush invisibility), Blinding Dart (7s flat, 680 range, blinds basic attacks only), Move Quick (14s), Toxic Shot (on-hit poison), Noxious Trap.
audit.corrected: Disguise credited for the hidden preparation; Blinding Dart's flat 7s and attack-only blind, Toxic Shot, Move Quick, Guerrilla Warfare and Noxious Trap all named.
sources: mirrorFindings: 'Inherent Glamour (P) is the ally disguise; Shapesplitter (W) is the clone'

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: zero cooldown-sequencing cues anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Blinding Dart's cooldown is a flat 7 seconds at every rank — the cleanest 'wait for X then Y' line in the matchup, and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: The 7s flat dart cooldown now appears in whys[1] and early as the explicit step-in cue.

audit.why: missingInteractions notes Toxic Shot applies on-hit and scales with attack speed — now named in wants.foe[1] so the poison is not read as flat poke.

edits.before: You're the teamfight flank now: disguise, walk into the clump, and R three people. Lane leads become fight wins.
edits.after: Your flank R still wins fights, but shroom-walled chokes and a relentless splitpush trade the map straight back.

edits.before: Your second Q point lets you re-bloom poke over the wave and the E threat keeps him honest — his blind can't stop spell damage.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is 7s flat and blinds basic attacks only — your Q re-bloom and E root land through it, so trade on its cooldown.

edits.before: Pop Blossom off a landed E is a full burst combo and likely kill; disguise/W lets you ult unseen so he can't kite the channel.
edits.after: Pop Blossom off a landed E is a full burst combo and likely kill; the disguise hides the preparation until the knockup hits.

edits.before: Pop Blossom off a landed E is a near-guaranteed kill — set it up disguised or under W invis so he never sees the channel.
edits.after: Pop Blossom off a landed E is a near-guaranteed kill — stay disguised and the preparation stays hidden until it lands.

edits.before: His shroom walls and global splitpush, not a 1v1, are the real threat — vision objectives before facechecking.
edits.after: Noxious Trap chokes and his splitpush, not a 1v1, are the threat — Guerrilla Warfare hides him in brush, so sweep.

edits.before: Teemo's blind (Q) is a small annoyance here, not a wall — you're a caster, so your damage comes from Q re-blooms and the E root, none of which his blind touches. Level 1 you have no combo and only single-target Q, so don't walk into his auto range to chuck it; last-hit at max Q range and eat a little poison. By 2-3 your second Q point and E let you re-bloom over the minions onto him and threaten a root the instant he steps up to farm — that's your first real punish window.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is a small annoyance here, not a wall — you are a caster, and Q re-blooms and the E root are untouched by a blind that only stops basic attacks. Level 1 you have no combo and single-target Q, so do not walk into his 680 auto range to throw it; last-hit from 800 and eat a little Toxic Shot poison. By 2-3 your second Q point and E let you re-bloom over the minions and threaten a root the moment he steps up — his dart is 7s flat, so step in as soon as it is spent.

edits.before: This is your lane. Your Q out-ranges and out-clears his autos, so shove the wave and force him off the XP, then look to land E (Tangle-Barbs) through the caster minions — it roots longer the more it travels. At 6, Pop Blossom converts a landed E into a full burst combo; set the ult up disguised as an ally or under your W clone-and-invis so he never sees the channel to kite or flash it. His poison and move speed can't out-trade your combo once the root lands.
edits.after: This is your lane. Your Q out-ranges his 680 autos and out-clears him, so shove and force him off the XP, then land E (Tangle-Barbs) through the caster minions — a tangle that passes through a target arrives bigger and roots longer. At 6, Pop Blossom converts a landed E into a full burst combo: stay disguised and the preparation is hidden, so he never sees it coming to Move Quick away. Toxic Shot and his move speed cannot out-trade your combo once the root lands.

edits.before: Hit 6 and ult unseen via disguise or W clone, then Pop Blossom on his step-up
edits.after: Hit 6 and stay disguised so the ult preparation is hidden, then R his step-up

edits.before: Blind (Q) your W-empowered third hit and any all-in autos every trade
edits.after: Blinding Dart your Shapesplitter third hit and any all-in autos every trade

edits.before: Kite back with passive move speed and poison (E) so your E never connects at melee
edits.after: Kite with Move Quick and stack Toxic Shot on-hit so your root never connects
